_comment: Machine-readable AMMO V2 artifact-path manifest. Sole source of the PATH FACTS that references/artifact-layout.md states in prose and that both variants' layout warn hooks enforce. Consumers: .codex/hooks/ammo-artifact-layout-warn.sh and .codex/hooks/post_tool_use_guard.py both derive their allowlist from `slots[].path_template` + `placeholders`; neither restates a path. Judgment (disambiguation rules, prohibited-pattern rationale, resolution order) stays prose in artifact-layout.md. skills/ammo/tests/test_artifact_layout_manifest.py holds doc<->manifest parity.
_placeholders_comment: Placeholder token -> regex fragment. A template segment holding no placeholder is matched literally. A trailing '/' makes the template a directory PREFIX (anything below it conforms); no trailing '/' makes it an exact file path. Consumers also accept every proper directory ancestor of a template, so a bare `rounds/3/sweeps` token is a directory reference, not drift.
_open_dirs_comment: Directories whose whole subtree conforms because the child filenames are agent-chosen, not a fixed set: the researcher adds mining evidence files, and the auditor writes per-cycle and per-track verdict filenames. The slots inside them stay enumerated below for their writer/gate/kind facts. Every other directory keeps its exact child set, so a track-root `validation_results_DRAFT.md` still warns.

state_json.notes: Shape + enums owned by schemas/state.schema.json. Sub-agents never write it.

state_lock.notes: Empty flock file. Every writer of state.json serializes on it, so it sits next to state.json and is never deleted. Carries no campaign data.

report_assets.notes: 5 required PNGs plus their gen_*.py generators.

validation_gate_report.notes: One cohort-wide mechanical gate result per round.

profiling_nsys.notes: Attribution traces. Holds baseline_bs{BS}.nsys-rep plus opt/{op_id}/, integration/ and post_ship/ subdirs. Traces NEVER land inside a sweep output dir.

profiling_ncu.notes: Targeted hardware counters (sanity.csv + sanity_results.md). Its latency column is NOT a baseline.

profiling_probe.notes: Read-compatibility only. Not scaffolded, not a Stage 2 ranking input.

sweep_baseline.notes: Clean Stage 1 E2E. Profiling flags forbidden. Holds json/golden_refs.json for Gate 5.1b.

sweep_profiling.notes: Latency here is contaminated. Never a timing authority.

sweep_profiling_prefill.notes: Contaminated latency AND shortened OSL, so any decode-shape claim needs a production-depth cross-check.

sweep_opt.notes: Clean per-track E2E timing authority. One per track per round; superseded runs archived.

sweep_opt_profiling.notes: Activation evidence only; latency is contaminated and never a timing authority.

sweep_integration.notes: Promoted baseline for round N+1 mining after a material SHIP, including when populated by the single-pass short-circuit.

sweep_integration_profiling.notes: Combined activation proof only; latency is contaminated.

sweep_golden_capture.notes: Emits json/golden_refs.json consumed by the next round's Gate 5.1b.

sweep_post_ship_profiling.notes: Optional post-SHIP re-attribution capture; traces route to profiling/nsys/post_ship/. Contaminated latency, and T16 stays eliminated so it is never mandatory.

mining_analysis.notes: Prose plus tables.md pasted verbatim. A hand-edited mined number is a BLOCKING audit finding.

mining_config.notes: Agent JUDGMENT only: segmentation policy, family labels + symbol patterns, trace-to-BS mapping, physical ceilings, prefill_active.

mining_mined_json.notes: Schema mine_trace/1. Sole writer of every mined number.

mining_tables.notes: The two mandated tables. Regenerated from mined.json; never hand-edited.

debate_eligibility.notes: CUT-4 four-gate verdict plus gated_revision. Write-once-then-append.

debate_proposals.notes: Phase 0. In debate sub-round 1 the proposal IS the argument-of-record.

debate_rounds.notes: D counts DEBATE sub-rounds, not campaign rounds. Holds {op_id}_{argument|critique_{target}|rebuttal}.md.

debate_summary.notes: Lead-authored human summary of the typed selected_candidates in state.json. Champions never write it; state.json wins any disagreement.

track_validation_results.notes: The ONLY authoritative file at the track root. check_projection_accuracy.py appends its section here.

track_evidence.notes: Structured primary-evidence index; read by verify_validation_gates.py and reconcile_track_state.py.

track_diff_patch.notes: Refreshed from the merge base after each gate-relevant commit. Required for review, resume, integration and PR extraction.

track_runtime_pkg_patch.notes: Written ONLY when a materialized runtime was edited, derived from the roots worktree setup recorded.

track_monitor_audits.notes: Impl-stage only. Monitors write here, never to the campaign root. Debate champions have no monitors, so there is no debate/monitor_audits/.

track_scratch.notes: All drafts, debug scripts and iteration logs. Drafts look like finals, so nothing here is ever cited as a verdict.

audit_stage_1.notes: Verdict for T_AUDIT_S1. The stage transition reads the matching audit.stage_1.passed_at stamp.

audit_stage_2.notes: Verdict for T_AUDIT_S2. The stage transition reads the matching audit.stage_2.passed_at stamp.

audit_stage_45.notes: Verdict for T_AUDIT_S45. The stage transition reads the matching audit.stage_45.passed_at stamp.

audit_stage_67.notes: Verdict for T_AUDIT_S67. The stage transition reads the matching audit.stage_67.passed_at stamp.

audit_stage45_partial.notes: Optional early per-track evidence, NOT a verdict. Consumed by the real auditor at T_AUDIT_S45.

archive.notes: Quarantined superseded runs. The ONLY place a timestamp may appear in a directory name.
